quote: Tachograph specifications for occasional passenger services and other improvements to smart tachograph — The draft implementing act aims to adapt the tachograph technical specifications to cater for new rules for drivers engaged in occasional passenger services, following the adoption of Regulation
title: Smart tachograph specifications — EU draft act for occasional passenger services
summary: The European Commission is preparing a draft implementing act adapting tachograph technical specifications to the new rules for drivers engaged in occasional passenger services, and adding further improvements and corrections. It evidences upcoming compliance change for operators and tachograph suppliers across the EU.

quote: Freezing of meat of domestic ungulates — Based on a new EFSA opinion on the storage of meat of domestic ungulates before freezing, alternative, equivalent storage conditions are proposed e.g. for a period up to 14 days at a lower temperature or when complying with a process hygiene criterion before
title: Meat freezing rules — EU draft act on storage of ungulate meat before freezing
summary: Based on a new EFSA opinion, the European Commission proposes alternative equivalent storage conditions for meat of domestic ungulates before freezing, such as a longer period at a lower temperature or compliance with a process hygiene criterion. It evidences a shift toward more risk-based flexibility for food business operators.

quote: Review of the International Procurement Instrument — The initiative aims to review the scope, functioning and efficiency of the International Procurement Instrument (IPI). It will focus on the assessment of all aspects of the IPI including the initiation of IPI investigations, the investigation proc
title: International Procurement Instrument — EU review of its scope and functioning
summary: The European Commission has opened a review of the International Procurement Instrument covering investigation initiation, the investigation process, consultations with third countries, thresholds and the conditions for imposing measures. It evidences possible change to how the EU restricts third-country access to public contracts.

quote: Revision of Schengen short-stay visa procedures (recast) — As set out in the EU Visa Strategy, the Commission will bring forward a legislative recast of the EU Visa Code. The initiative will make Schengen visa rules more strategic, coherent and effective, strengthening tools on security, migration,
title: Schengen short-stay visa rules — EU Visa Code recast planned by the Commission
summary: Under the EU Visa Strategy the European Commission will bring forward a legislative recast of the Visa Code, strengthening security, migration, readmission and third-country cooperation tools while facilitating legitimate travel. It evidences forthcoming procedural change to Schengen visa handling and the systems that support it.

quote: Vyhláška o portálu kritické infrastruktury — Vydání vyhlášky předpokládá § 20 odst. 9 a § 29 odst. 2 zákona č. 266/2025 Sb., o odolnosti subjektů kritické infrastruktury a o změně souvisejících zákonů (zákon o kritické infrastruktuře).
title: Critical infrastructure portal — Czech draft decree in the legislative pipeline
summary: A draft Czech decree covering the critical infrastructure portal, filed in the government's legislative process and already discussed by the working commission. It evidences that a central state portal for critical infrastructure is being put on a legal footing.

quote: Nařízení vlády, 347/2016 Sb., o sazbách poplatků na odbornou činnost Státního úřadu pro jadernou bezpečnost (Nařízení vlády o poplatcích SÚJB) — Navýšení poplatků na odbornou činnost SÚJB na základě zadání vlády. Navýšení reflektuje inflaci za předchozí léta, když tyto poplatky od roku 2017 nebyly n
title: SÚJB fee rates — Czech draft government regulation on nuclear-safety authority charges
summary: A draft Czech government regulation on the fee rates for the expert activity of SÚJB (the State Office for Nuclear Safety), tied to regulation 347/2016 Sb. and currently in the inter-ministerial comment procedure. It evidences that the charges the nuclear regulator levies for its expert work are being reopened in the legislative process.

quote: Vyhláška, kterou se mění vyhláška č. 298/2014 Sb., o stanovení seznamu katastrálních území s přiřazenými průměrnými základními cenami zemědělských pozemků, ve znění pozdějších předpisů — na základě zmocňovacího ustanovení § 17 zákona č. 338/1992 Sb., o dani z nemovitých věcí, ve znění pozdějších pře
title: Agricultural land price table — Czech draft decree updating per-cadastre base prices
summary: A draft Czech decree amending decree 298/2014 Sb., which sets the list of cadastral territories with their assigned average base prices of agricultural land, now in the comment procedure. It evidences a pending update to the official price table used to value agricultural land by cadastral area.

quote: Návrh poslanců Andreje Babiše, Borise Šťastného, Petra Macinky, Tomia Okamury, Radima Fialy a Taťány Malé na vydání zákona, kterým se mění zákon č. 273/2008 Sb., o Policii České republiky, ve znění pozdějších předpisů (sněmovní tisk č. 297) — Žádost o stanovisko k návrhu zákona, jehož předkladatelem
title: Police Act amendment — MPs' bill amending Act 273/2008 Sb., now in the comment procedure
summary: A bill from a group of deputies amending Act 273/2008 Sb. on the Police of the Czech Republic (parliamentary print 297), circulated by the Office of the Government of the Czech Republic under the Minister and chair of the Government Legislative Council. It evidences a legislature-initiated change to the Czech police statute now in the government's comment procedure.
